items.title: Drupal核心异常条件校验缺失致强制浏览
items.title_zh: Drupal核心异常条件校验缺失致强制浏览
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可构造请求绕过异常条件检查，直接访问受限路径与资源，影响多个核心版本
items.action_zh: 升级Drupal核心至官方修复版本，或临时限制敏感路径直接访问
items.repro_note: 直接请求受限路径或文件，验证是否绕过异常条件校验
items.impact_scope: 开源CMS核心，互联网站点广泛部署
items.description: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.23, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.23, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.14.

items.title: GeoServer XXE未授权读取本地文件
items.title_zh: GeoServer XXE未授权读取本地文件
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById的ID参数注入XML外部实体，读取本地文件或发起SSRF
items.action_zh: 升级GeoServer至官方修复版本，临时禁用WFS 2.0存储查询
items.repro_note: 未授权请求WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById，在ID参数注入XML实体
items.impact_scope: GIS服务中间件，常直接暴露公网
items.description: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

items.title: GeoServer服务级角色校验未授权绕过
items.title_zh: GeoServer服务级角色校验未授权绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者构造带服务前缀参数的请求，绕过服务级角色检查并调用受保护操作
items.action_zh: 升级GeoServer至修复版本，并复核服务级角色配置
items.repro_note: 未授权发送带服务前缀参数的请求，验证角色校验被绕过
items.impact_scope: GIS服务中间件，常直接暴露公网
items.description: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

items.title: MemberPress插件权限提升
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用插件错误的权限分配提升账号权限，进而控制WordPress站点
items.action_zh: 更新MemberPress Discord插件至官方修复版本，或临时停用
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in expresstechsoftware MemberPress Discord Addon expresstechsoftwares-memberpress-discord-add-on allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MemberPress Discord Addon: from n/a through 1.1.5.
